name: Chris Hench
subject: 20 Year Old at Middlebury, Building Voice AI
body:
Hi Chris,

My name is Max. I'm 20 years old and a sophomore at Middlebury building an AI startup. You co-authored MASSIVE, the 1-million-example multilingual NLU dataset that helps Alexa understand 51 languages.

I'm building voice agents and want to know what problems in conversational AI are actually worth solving right now. If you had 10 minutes to chat, I am hungry to learn. I promise I'll pay it forward!

Max
